summary: Retest of Sprint A after iteration_4 fixes. BOTH HIGH bugs CONFIRMED FIXED. (1) ExportPdfButton: clicking [data-testid='dashboard-export-pdf'] triggers a Playwright expect_download event yielding 'prosper-admin-2026-05-12.pdf' at 6472 bytes; ZERO 'RangeError: Offset is outside the bounds of the DataView' in pageerror/console; sonner toast 'Dashboard PDF downloaded' rendered. (2) OpsQueuePanel: [data-testid='ops-queue-status'] is present in the DOM and renders 'Live · ws' on /admin — WebSocket DOES forward through the preview ingress as main agent confirmed. Regression: 32/32 pytest cases (23 phase2_dashboard + 9 sprint_a) PASS in 6.66s. Frontend regression: all 6 KPI tiles, 3 SVG charts (nav/volume/revenue), top-clients, recent-activity (8 rows), refresh, range switcher 7d/30d/90d all present with their testids; no build-error overlay; 0 console errors; 0 pageerrors. Ready to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: ExportPdfButton onClick now correctly uses try/catch/finally with sonner toasts on both success and failure — good. Built-in Helvetica/Courier removes the network-fetched font failure mode. Consider also catching synchronous throws from `pdf(doc)` constructor (currently only the awaited toBlob is inside try) — minor, low risk.

OpsQueuePanel now binds wsStatus correctly. Note: the brief wording said 'connected' but the implementation uses 'live' for the WS-up state and matches WsStatus type — consistent end-to-end, no action needed.

Carry-over from iter_4 (not in scope for this retest): nav_snapshots unique index created after insert_many is still a multi-replica race; recent_activity org lookup is still per-row roundtrip. Both non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Export PDF download + toast ✓, ops-queue-status testid='Live · ws' ✓, KPIs ✓, charts ✓, top-clients ✓, recent-activity 8 rows ✓, refresh ✓, range switcher ✓, no build-error overlay ✓, 0 console errors)
